content:
kevin: Quick sync — product wants a side-by-side canary vs baseline dashboard for A/B checks. They want regression flags on latency, token cost, and correctness proxies. Can runtime + console help define a compact telemetry contract we can roll out?

liz: +1. We need stable label set (route, route_version, model_variant, region, tier). Also an exposure denominator so we can do normalized deltas.

tara: For runtime, we can emit these surface metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency (in ms), per-token compute cost (estimated cents/token), kv_cache_hit_rate, avg_batch_size, request_error_rate, fallback_count, model_switch_count. Any others?

mike: Add "prefix_cache_hit_bytes" (useful for prefix-heavy workloads) and "effective_seq_len" (to normalize token cost). Also include `route_id` and `experiment_id` labels so console can slice by A/B.

kevin: Thanks — can we agree on names? Proposing snake_case metric names to match current infra:
- inference.latency_ms
- inference.tokens_per_usd
- inference.kv_cache_hit_rate
- inference.avg_batch_size
- inference.request_error_rate
- inference.fallback_count
- inference.model_switch_count
- inference.prefix_cache_hit_bytes
- inference.effective_seq_len

liz: Those look fine. Two integration notes: 1) metrics land in datadog/grafana via our statsd pipeline; we need consistent tag keys: route, route_version, model_variant, region, tier, experiment_id, deployment_tier. 2) For pXX quantiles we prefer histograms with explicit p95/p99 gauges emitted by runtime to avoid relying on downstream aggregations.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: new metric config uploaded to metrics-registry (pending review).

mike: Wire format proposal (runtime emits a compact JSON event to the metrics forwarder). Example:

```json
{
  "metric": "inference.latency_ms",
  "value": 124.3,
  "labels": {"route":"checkout/confirm","route_version":"1.2.0","model_variant":"redwood-7b-q4","region":"us-east-1","tier":"hosted","experiment_id":"exp-2026-03-compare-a"},
  "quantiles": {"p50":48.2,"p95":120.1,"p99":312.7},
  "sample_rate": 1.0
}
```

liz: Good. Two asks: include `request_id` on debug-levels only (PII/trace hygiene) and emit a separate `exposure.count` metric per label set so the dashboard can compute normalized deltas for small-sample corrections.

tara: Runtime can add `exposure.count` as `inference.exposure_count` incremented per request. We'll also tag `cache_hit` boolean for sampling if we need to compute hit rates client-side.

kevin: For dashboard UX — console should show: left column baseline, right column canary, middle column delta + significance markers. Delta triggers: shaded yellow at >5% p95 delta and red at >10% or p99 spike. Also show a tiny panel for per-route traffic % to avoid misinterpreting noisy small-sample deltas.

mike: On alerting: prefer rolling-window bootstrap alerts — e.g., compare last 30m canary vs last-7d baseline bucketed same local-hour. We can add a `canary_vs_baseline_zscore` derived series but runtime doesn't need to compute it.

liz: We'll add renderer panels and a derived timeseries in grafana. Need `experiment_id` and `exposure.count` to compute significance. Also we'll surface raw request sample rate so SRE can turn on/off more aggressive sampling.

kevin: One more policy Q: for Dedicated customers that disable telemetry, we should still produce local per-host metrics but mark `telemetry_opt_out=true` label so console can hide cross-customer comparisons. Agree?

tara: Yep — runtime will emit `telemetry_opt_out=true|false` tag on metrics when available.

sre-bot: incident-bot: FYI — there was a spike in inference.latency_ms in prod earlier today, linked to model variant autoscaling. Not related to this thread but might influence thresholds.

mike: Action items:
- runtime (tara): implement metric names + labels + exposure counter, add p95/p99 gauges, include `telemetry_opt_out` tag. Target PR by EOD Fri.
- console (liz): build grafana/console panels and derived delta series, wire experiment_id filter, draft alerting rules. Target mock by next Wed.
- eng-platform (kevin): coordinate rollout plan + doc for SDK/metrics-registry.

kevin: If anyone wants to push back on names/labels now's the time. If not, I'll open the metrics registry ticket and tag owners. :thumbsup: 

liz: LGTM from console side.

tara: 👍 will start the PR.

mike: I'll prototype the significance job and share queries.

kevin: Great — thanks team. We'll reconvene after PR review.
